sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A shrinking-arena fight with a hard-fail breakbar attack and constant moving hazards. 8-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Howling Death (breakbar)
bullets: <mark>Howling Death</mark> gives the boss a defiance bar — if it isn't broken in time, it inflicts an uncleansable Fear that sends the whole squad fleeing off the platform, which is a wipe. This is the one mechanic that can never be missed.
It appears after every other Death Bloom cast and despawns all active Surging Souls when it happens — a brief breather to focus the bar.

sections.heading: Shrinking arena
bullets: The platform shrinks at 90%, 66%, and 33% health — anyone standing on the edge when it happens falls and dies. Move toward center as those thresholds approach (in Challenge Mote, the arena starts crumbled, so the late fight is cramped from the beginning).

sections.heading: Adds & hazards
bullets: Tormented Dead spawn every 20s after 90% health and fixate the inactive tank — kill them at range; their death leaves a deceptively large, high-damage AoE, so don't stand near the kill.

<mark>Surging Souls</mark> (from 7:50 remaining): moving walls that instantly kill on contact and can't be dodged, invulned, or blocked — the gaps are randomized each time, so stay mobile rather than memorizing a path. They disappear once the boss's defiance bar is up.
<mark>Spinning Slash</mark>: a slow-moving scythe hazard that converts your boons into conditions on contact — easy to avoid if you're paying attention, punishing if you're not.
<mark>Death Bloom</mark>: an 8-cone circular strike for heavy damage — stay out of the cones.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 8:00 — Soulless Horror deals +200% damage past this point.
